cinematic: Cinematic film still in the evening or night, shot on 35mm Kodak Portra 800, visible film grain, slight halation around lights, soft focus falloff, natural imperfect framing. Warm, hopeful, cozy atmosphere: plenty of warm golden practical light (lamps, windows, string lights, street lights) against a soft blue night, the scene feels safe, gentle and alive, never gloomy, scary or lonely. Minimal composition: ONE clear subject with calm negative space, few background elements, nothing cluttered. Realistic human scale and proportions between people, objects and buildings. Faces must NOT be clearly visible: show people from behind, in silhouette, or small and far away. Vertical 9:16 phone wallpaper. Not glossy, not over-sharpened, no HDR, no watermark, no logo
anime: Polished cinematic anime key visual, the quality of a theatrical anime film poster. Bold graphic composition: a vast, clean sky of one rich colour (deep indigo or violet at night, saturated cobalt blue at dusk, clear soft blue in the daytime, warm peach at golden hour) with a smooth gradient fills the top 55-65% of the frame, almost empty: no busy clouds, at most a few stars or one moon. The subject sits in the lower third as one strong, readable silhouette or shape. Very limited palette: one dominant cool colour plus one warm accent light (lamp, lantern, window, moon, fire) that draws the eye. High contrast, crisp clean shapes, smooth confident shading, refined detail only on the subject; no sketchy outlines, no paper texture, no watercolour, no clutter. Warm, hopeful, quietly romantic mood. Realistic scale between people, objects and landscape. Vertical 9:16 phone wallpaper, no watermark, no logo
